criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: CreatorOf
categories.definition: One entity is the creator, author, designer, developer, composer, or producer of the other.

categories.name: LocatedIn
categories.definition: One entity is physically situated within the geographical area of the other.

categories.name: MemberOfGroup
categories.definition: One entity is a person, team, or smaller unit that belongs to or participates in a larger group, organization, or event.

categories.name: AwardRecipient
categories.definition: One entity has received or been nominated for an award or title represented by the other.

categories.name: PlatformFor
categories.definition: One entity is a software or content and the other is the hardware or operating system it runs on or is compatible with.

categories.name: ProfessionOrRole
categories.definition: One entity describes the profession, official role, or field of study of the other.

categories.name: VariantOrAlias
categories.definition: One entity is an alternative name, translation, or variant form of the other.

categories.name: PublisherOrDistributor
categories.definition: One entity is a creative work (e.g., film, album, book) and the other is the company that publishes, broadcasts, or distributes it.

categories.name: ParentOrganizationOf
categories.definition: One entity is a larger organization that owns, governs, or contains the other.

categories.name: FamilyRelation
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other by family ties (e.g., parent, child, sibling).

categories.name: TributaryOf
categories.definition: One entity is a river or stream that flows into the other.

categories.name: InstanceOf
categories.definition: One entity is an example or specific type of the broader category represented by the other.

categories.name: ListedOn
categories.definition: One entity is officially recorded or designated on a list or register represented by the other.

categories.name: LanguageOf
categories.definition: One entity is written, spoken, or performed in the language of the other.

categories.name: TemporalSuccession
categories.definition: One entity precedes, succeeds, or is a version/part of the other in time.

categories.name: PoliticalAffiliation
categories.definition: One entity is a person and the other is their political party or ideology.

categories.name: NationalityOrOrigin
categories.definition: One entity is a person, group, or product, and the other is their country or region of origin or citizenship.

categories.name: HomeGroundOrVenue
categories.definition: One entity is a sports team or event, and the other is its primary venue or location.

categories.name: CharacterIn
categories.definition: One entity is a fictional character and the other is the work they appear in.

categories.name: PlaysInstrument
categories.definition: One entity is a person and the other is the musical instrument they play.

categories.name: AssociatedWithFieldOrStyle
categories.definition: One entity is a person, concept, or work associated with a particular field, movement, or artistic style.

categories.name: OwnerOf
categories.definition: One entity legally possesses or controls the other.

categories.name: FlowsInto
categories.definition: One entity is a body of water that empties into another.

categories.name: GeopoliticalRelation
categories.definition: Describes a spatial or political relationship between two geographical or political entities, such as annexation or being located between.

categories.name: PartiallyComposedOf
categories.definition: One entity is a component or subdivision of the other.

categories.name: Co-occurrence
categories.definition: Two entities are mentioned together as examples of a similar type or context, without a direct hierarchical or causal link.

categories.name: AgentOfAction
categories.definition: One entity is an action or event, and the other is the person or group performing that action.

categories.name: ServesLocation
categories.definition: One entity provides a service to or is designated for a specific location.

categories.name: AssociatedWithTime
categories.definition: One entity is a person or event, and the other is a specific year or period of time with which they are directly associated.

categories.name: ServiceProvidedBy
categories.definition: One entity is a location or facility, and the other is the service provider that operates or serves it.
